patterns.note: Full-width sections with generous vertical padding, often alternating between dark and light backgrounds to create distinct visual breaks. Content within sections is typically centered or uses a grid for multiple items.

A sophisticated, high-contrast pairing of a large, elegant serif display font for major headings and a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation. Uppercase text is used for labels and subheadings to add structure.

A dominant dark charcoal/black background contrasted with crisp white or very light text. Accents are subtle, often muted purples or warm neutrals, used sparingly for CTAs or subtle overlays rather than bright, saturated hues.

A sticky header navigation bar remains visible at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling. The initial hero section features a large background image that remains fixed or slowly parallaxes as foreground content scrolls over it, creating a sense of depth.
Prominent partner/client logo showcases are integrated early in the page flow, often presented in a minimalist grid, to immediately establish authority and social proof.

technique_notes: A fixed header navigation bar is used, which maintains its position at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to site navigation.

The initial hero section employs a large, full-width background image that is either fixed in place or uses a subtle parallax effect, allowing textual content and calls to action to scroll over it, creating a layered depth effect.
Content sections are structured with ample vertical spacing and often alternate between dark and light background colors to visually separate them and guide the user's eye down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant display headings (approx. 3-4x body text) with generous line height, paired with a clear, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and some image containers have a slight curve, not sharp, not fully rounded).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical padding between sections, ample whitespace around elements, especially in the hero and major content blocks).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a sophisticated, editorial aesthetic, characterized by its elegant serif display font, dark moody color palette, and large, impactful imagery, sets it apart. It avoids typical bright, energetic marketing visuals, instead opting for a more refined, almost art-gallery feel that lends an air of gravitas and authority to its niche service.
